note: Menu Multilingual filters menu links in menu blocks by translation status for the current language. It adds two checkboxes to the config form of system_menu_block / menu_block instances, stored as third-party settings on the block config entity: block.block.<id>.third_party_settings.menu_multilingual.only_translated_labels and .only_translated_content (booleans). A #pre_render on the block runs the menu_multilingual.modifier service to drop untranslated links (and their children). No config route, no permissions, no Drush. Medium cases place a menu block with a known setting and read it back. Hard cases place a menu block with the setting OFF and require the agent to turn it ON, verified via getThirdPartySetting on the block config entity; reset sets it back to false so verify fails on empty state.

evals.prompt: Using the Menu Multilingual module, how do I make a menu block hide menu links whose label has not been translated into the current language, and what setting does that correspond to?
must_contain_any: Hide menu items without translated label
evals.expected_output: Edit the menu block's configuration and tick 'Hide menu items without translated label'. It is saved as the third-party setting only_translated_labels: true on the block config entity (block.block.<id>.third_party_settings.menu_multilingual).

evals.prompt: Which kinds of blocks does the Menu Multilingual module add its multilingual filtering options to?
evals.expected_output: Blocks whose plugin id is system_menu_block (core system menu blocks) or menu_block (the contrib Menu block module). Other block types are untouched.

evals.prompt: In Menu Multilingual, what happens to the child menu items of a menu link that gets filtered out for being untranslated?
evals.expected_output: When a menu item is filtered away, all of its sub-menu items (children) are removed too. If a block ends up with no items it renders empty.

evals.prompt: A menu block with the id 'mm_eval_labels' is placed on this site. Inspect its configuration and tell me which Menu Multilingual filtering it has enabled: hiding items without a translated label, without translated content, or both?
evals.expected_output: Only label filtering: block.block.mm_eval_labels has third_party_settings.menu_multilingual.only_translated_labels = true and only_translated_content = false (`drush cget block.block.mm_eval_labels third_party_settings.menu_multilingual`).

evals.prompt: There is a menu block 'mm_eval_content' on this site configured with Menu Multilingual. Look at its live configuration and state which multilingual option is turned on.
evals.expected_output: Content filtering: block.block.mm_eval_content has third_party_settings.menu_multilingual.only_translated_content = true (and only_translated_labels = false).

evals.prompt: A menu block with id 'mm_task' is placed on this site. Using Menu Multilingual, configure it so that menu links without a translated label in the current language are hidden. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: block.block.mm_task carries third_party_settings.menu_multilingual.only_translated_labels = true. e.g. $b = Block::load('mm_task'); $b->setThirdPartySetting('menu_multilingual','only_translated_labels', TRUE)->save(); (or tick 'Hide menu items without translated label' on the block's config form).

evals.prompt: The menu block 'mm_content_task' is placed on this site. Configure it with Menu Multilingual so that menu links pointing to content that is not translated into the current language are hidden. Save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: block.block.mm_content_task carries third_party_settings.menu_multilingual.only_translated_content = true (set via $b->setThirdPartySetting('menu_multilingual','only_translated_content', TRUE)->save() or the block config form checkbox 'Hide menu items without translated content').
